entities.name: J. Ira Courtney
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: John Ira Courtney was an American sprinter who competed at the 1912 Summer Olympics in the 100 m, 200 m and 4 × 100 m relay events. In 1909–1914, he won several championships as a sprinter and hurdler and later became a handball player.
